question: Should the remaining visible media-placeholder behavior be solved as a Signal-specific transport fix, or by adding a new documented default-off `messages` config surface for affected channels?
rationale: Current main already fixed iMessage channel-locally, while Signal still sends visible placeholders and repository policy sets a high bar for new global config keys.

options.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
options.body: Keep defaults compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.

options.title: Add global messages setting
options.body: Introduce a documented default-off suppression option with strict schema, metadata/help/docs, and tests across every affected outbound channel.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Leave placeholders visible as the delivery/accessibility fallback and close the request only after an explicit maintainer product decision.

recommendation.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
recommendation.body: Keep defaults compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Signal path and already reviewed this issue as the canonical product/config request.
